user.title: Your electricity plan
user.description: Set up your time-of-use plan -- any retailer, not just GloBird. You'll enter your import/export rate schedule next, so have your bill or your retailer's price fact sheet handy. The GloBird ZEROHERO extras below are optional: leave them off unless you're on that plan.

data.enable_zerohero: GloBird ZeroHero: daily credit for a quiet evening peak
data.enable_zws: GloBird ZeroWastedSolar: boosted export rate up to a daily cap
data.enable_zerolimits: GloBird ZeroLimits: critical peak event pricing

import_schedule.title: Import (grid consumption) price schedule
import_schedule.description: Enter each time-of-use window for what you pay to import from the grid. Leave a window's rate blank if unused. Windows must cover the full 24 hours with no gaps or overlaps.

export_schedule.title: Export (feed-in) price schedule
export_schedule.description: Enter each time-of-use window for what you're paid to export to the grid. Leave a window's rate blank if unused. Windows must cover the full 24 hours with no gaps or overlaps.

zerohero.title: ZeroHero credit
zerohero.description: GloBird pays a daily credit if your grid import stays under a threshold during the evening peak window.

zerowastedsolar.title: ZeroWastedSolar
zerowastedsolar.description: GloBird pays a boosted export rate for the first N kWh you export during the evening peak.

zerolimits.title: ZeroLimits critical peak events
zerolimits.description: GloBird occasionally declares a critical peak event via the app (no public API). Either let this integration create its own toggle to flip on manually, or point it at an existing helper entity you already use for this.

data.zerolimits_entity: Existing helper entity (leave blank to use the built-in toggle)

error.schedule_empty: At least one window is required.
error.schedule_gap: The windows you entered don't cover the full 24 hours -- there's a gap.
error.schedule_overlap: Two or more windows overlap. Each window must be non-overlapping.
error.schedule_invalid_time: One of the times entered isn't a valid HH:MM value.
